title: That Day, That Moment, Chanko Nabe

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here! Canned mackerel mixed rice, ready
to eat! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When we realized we'd be camping out
waiting for the first bus, Hishi Akebono
whipped out a portable gas burner and
multiple cooking utensils to make us a
delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that smell good? I think it turned
out juuust right. And don't
worry, there's
plenty of leftovers, so eat your fill,
okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a bite and marvel at the flavors
I'm tasting. The warm rice soothes both my
heart and aching body. I'm reminded of
just how
resourceful she is in a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But I wouldn't be half the cook I am today
without my parents.
They're both amazing
cooks themselves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The soups and hot pots they make are filled with the sweetest of stocks, and their hamburgers and fried chicken are extra juicy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever people taste their food, a big
smile follows each bite. It's
absolutely
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that,
I could feel this desire well up
inside me. I wanna be a
racer that makes
people smile too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That story didn't end how I expected it
to.
Wouldn't it be easier for
her to bring
people joy through her cooking?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious, I ask her why she would enter
Tracen instead of a culinary
school.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: How do I put this... Hmmm, you see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, I wanted to be a big pot
of chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My apparent confusion encourages Hishi
Akebono to continue her
story, and she
tells me of a television special she
witnessed as a child.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Today we'd like to highlight the hot pot
sumo wrestlers often eat—chanko. Our
guests today are former sumo wrestlers
who made
this dish regularly.

text_block_list.name: Former Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Chanko is something we wrestlers eat
every day as a group. It fills our
bellies
while also giving us the energy needed to
grow stronger.

text_block_list.name: Former Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
But it's especially important after a
hard-fought match. A satisfying meal
enjoyed while surrounded by friends...
Nothing gets you more ready to keep
working hard than that.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! Chanko's the best thing everrr!
So that's why sumo wrestlers
are so strong!
They eat lots and lots of the heartiest
hot pot ever!

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I grow up, I wanna be a pot of
chanko! Then I'll gather
everybody in the
same place and get 'em ready to work
hard too!

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh. If I'm the hot pot,
does that mean
I can't have any?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Realizing that, I gave up on literally becoming a pot of chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But even if I knew I couldn't actually
be a hot pot, that special still
stuck with me. I
read books on the subject, made my own
recipes...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And then one day, I heard something
wonderful while watching a
post-match
interview on TV.

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
He was strong, all right—too strong. I can
tell now that I wasn't ready
for this fight,
but...
I still gave it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mama, why is the sumo wrestler smiling?
He lost, didn't he? He was
crying just
before...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm sure he's proud of himself and
what he managed to do.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what he said? He gave
this fight everything he's got. Going up
against a big,
strong fighter is a lot harder than it
sounds.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But he still did it. I'm sure he's very,
very
happy.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I get it... He's probably got a warm, full
feeling in his tummy. That's...
kinda like
what happens when they eat chanko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think what little me was trying to
say is that if I can go up against a
strong
opponent with everything I got, maybe I
can become a chanko after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a runner that gives every
race
her all! That way, whether I
win or lose, I'll
still make people smile!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I entered Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hearing that must've been a bit of a
surprise, huh? Well, I'm
surprised too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I think this is the first time I ever put my thoughts into words. Obviously I knew I wanted to make people smile with my racing, but I never really thought about why.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought a TV special could
have such an effect on my
running.
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tale ended up being a bit of a
whirlwind experience for both of
us, but I
have a better idea of what motivates her
now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yawn...Finally back at school. What a trip, huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive back at the academy a little
after eight o' clock. Despite my aching
body and a general lack of sleep, I don't
actually feel that
tired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one could tell she just spend the night
camping. In fact, she looks
incredibly
well-rested.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've got a scrimmage today, so I
should get going. Go home and
get plenty
of rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Huh? Didn't I tell you?
